bank_sync.name: Synchronize transactions
bank_sync.description: Downloads latest transactions from all linked bank accounts and inserts them into Actual Budget.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to perform the bank sync on.

budget_sync.name: Synchronize budgets
budget_sync.description: Downloads latest budget file from the server and update sensor entities.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to perform the budget sync on.

add_transaction.name: Add transaction
add_transaction.description: Creates (or updates, if imported_id matches an existing transaction) a transaction in Actual Budget. Useful for recording bills/invoices from other integrations precisely, without waiting on a generic bank sync.

config_entry_id.name: Actual Budget instance
config_entry_id.description: Select the Actual Budget instance to add the transaction to.

account.name: Account
account.description: Name of the Actual Budget account to add the transaction to.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Positive for a deposit, negative for a payment/expense.

payee.name: Payee
payee.description: Payee name. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional free-text note on the transaction.

category.name: Category
category.description: Optional budget category. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.

imported_id.name: Imported ID
imported_id.description: Optional stable unique id (e.g. an invoice number). Calling this action again with the same imported_id updates that transaction instead of creating a duplicate.
